capabilities: Fold and cycle headings and the whole note with Tab and Shift-Tab
Treat folded headings as one line for Vim line operators and text objects
Edit Markdown tables org-mode style: navigate, align, move, insert, and delete rows and columns
Move, promote, and demote subtrees and list items with Alt-h/j/k/l
Show outline-based indent mode and compact, uniform headings
disambiguation: Not an org-mode file editor; it applies org-mode editing keys to Markdown headings, lists, and tables in Obsidian's Vim mode.
extras: Uses undocumented Obsidian interfaces for Vim mode, so an Obsidian update can stop the plugin; the keys require the core 'Vim key bindings' setting to be on, and most keys only work in Vim normal and visual mode.
intentEvidence: The keys operate as in the Emacs package evil-org-mode.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Vim mode has no org-mode-style outline folding, subtree operations, or org-table editing keys.

relations.evidence: The keys operate as in the Emacs package evil-org-mode.
Vim Motions has i| and a| also.

summary: Vim-mode keymap that adds org-mode headline folding, subtree and list editing, and org-style table editing keys to Obsidian's editor.
